2608.13459.title: CAPRI: Contract-Aware Proof Repair for Isabelle
2608.13459.paper_summary: We address the use of large language models (LLMs) to help discover Isabelle proofs. An Isabelle build establishes that the submitted theory is accepted, but not that an LLM changed only what the developer authorised. We present CAPRI, a contract-aware repair workflow in which Isabelle checks the proof and an independent checker enforces a machine-readable edit contract. Prompts, proposals, candidate repositories, diagnostics, verdicts, and hashes are retained for audit. We evaluate five workflows on twelve failed proofs from four developments, with three replicates per task and condition, giving 180 runs and 138 valid repairs. Of 144 terminal candidates accepted by Isabelle, six had modified protected text; all arose in iterative workflows that could edit a complete theory. A proof-body-only interface produced 29/36 valid repairs and no contract violations, compared with 31/36 for the corresponding full-theory workflow. One-shot repair produced 22/36, while a later prospectively frozen iterative workflow produced 32/36; these figures compare complete workflows rather than individual mechanisms. A separate post hoc OpenRouter campaign found no improvement in the designated Luna comparisons. A Sol configuration with matched demonstrations produced 33/36 repairs, compared with 29/36 in the frozen OpenAI Responses condition, but the difference was not statistically significant in a one-sided exact McNemar test ($p=0.0625$).
2608.13459.paper_summary_zh: 我們探討使用大型語言模型（LLMs）來幫助發現Isabelle證明。Isabelle構建確立了提交的理論被接受，但並不意味著LLM僅更改了開發者授權的內容。我們提出了CAPRI，一個合約感知的修復工作流程，其中Isabelle檢查證明，而一個獨立的檢查器強制執行機器可讀的編輯合約。提示、提案、候選庫、診斷、裁決和哈希值都保留以便審計。我們在四個開發中的十二個失敗證明上評估了五個工作流程，每個任務和條件下有三次重複，總共進行了180次運行和138次有效修復。在144個被Isabelle接受的終端候選中，有六個修改了受保護的文本；所有這些都出現在可以編輯完整理論的迭代工作流程中。僅證明主體的介面產生了29/36的有效修復，且沒有合約違規，相比之下，對應的完整理論工作流程為31/36。一次性修復產生了22/36，而後來的前瞻性凍結迭代工作流程產生了32/36；這些數字比較的是完整的工作流程，而不是單個機制。另一個事後的OpenRouter活動發現指定的Luna比較沒有改善。一個具有匹配示範的Sol配置產生了33/36的修復，而在凍結的OpenAI Responses條件下為29/36，但在單側精確的McNemar檢驗中，這一差異在統計上並不顯著（$p=0.0625$）。
